sources.entry: Radicale - Simple calendar and contact server with extremely low administrative overhead. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 Python/deb

summary.one_liner: Radicale is a small CalDAV (calendar and to-do) and CardDAV (contacts) server that stores its data as plain files on disk.
summary.what_it_does: Radicale serves calendars and contact lists over CalDAV, CardDAV and HTTP. It handles events, todos, journal entries and business cards. The README says it works out of the box with no complicated setup, and that it can limit access through authentication and secure connections with TLS. Data is stored on the file system in a simple folder structure. The README also says it works with many CalDAV and CardDAV clients and can be extended with plugins. The README does not give install steps, so the setup details are in the external documentation it links to.
use_cases: personal calendar server with low admin overhead
notable: Plain file-system storage in a simple folder structure
Works out of the box with minimal configuration, per the README
Supports events, todos, journal entries and business cards
caveats: The README does not include install or run instructions; it points to external documentation
Setup, authentication and TLS details are only summarized, not described
